dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. For every included clinic, procedures[] contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed public price/treatment pages, not only Botox, fillers, rhinoplasty, breast augmentation, hair transplant or peels.
limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, unindexed or phone-only prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, per-unit, per-vial, per-syringe and per-graft semantics are preserved.
Public specials are preserved and marked with price_type=special or special_range where identified.
KBeauty Medi Spa and Jaime S. Schwartz rows sourced from public pricing directories are explicitly marked source_type=public_pricing_directory.
Ratings are source-specific and may refer to a clinic location, practice, or website review aggregate.
Some newly-added surgical prices come from public pricing directories rather than the clinic's own price page; these rows are explicitly marked source_type=public_pricing_directory.
Directory-derived rows are kept separate from official-public-price rows so the app can rank trust levels differently.
